gen-gf-fanwood-text-manrope: Short-looking ascenders give Fanwood Text a low, tucked-in profile, with only a modest shift in weight around each curve, while Manrope runs beside it in one steady line. Big and short is where the heading earns its place.
gen-gf-fanwood-text-montserrat: Fanwood Text draws gently modulated curves that never snag the eye, with a quiet editorial polish. And Montserrat glides along in a rounded-nib line, wide and generous inside every bowl.
gen-gf-fanwood-text-satoshi: Fanwood Text carries a measured swell from hairline to stem, giving it a classic, editorial hand. Satoshi keeps every stroke at one width, so a long run of sans-serif text stays open and easy on the eye.
gen-gf-fanwood-text-switzer: Gentle swelling softens every curve of Fanwood Text. Its short-looking ascenders sit well at big, brief sizes, while Switzer holds a wire-like, tubular line that never shifts its thickness around a bend.
gen-gf-farro-fs-erode: Farro draws tall, rounded lowercase with the uninterrupted line of a technical pen, giving headings a friendly, professional footing. Erode follows with a soft, understated stroke change, so the text serif feels warm beneath it.
gen-gf-farro-fs-karma: Rounded lowercase bowls, like blown glass bulbs, make Farro instantly recognizable, and every stroke keeps a single thickness. Karma follows with a lightly flexed, spring-wire contrast, adding a trustworthy, classic voice beneath it.
gen-gf-fauna-one-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Fauna One lifts its x-height close to the capitals, giving a bookish, classic voice with curves that stop short of closing. And Be Vietnam Pro supplies bent-steel strokes of one weight, leaving the pairing feeling clean.
gen-gf-fauna-one-fs-merriweather-sans: Sturdy, tall lowercase make Merriweather Sans read large and clear, with an e whose eye opens to the right. Fauna One earns its keep up top, classic and bookish when set big and short.
gen-gf-faustina-archivo: Faustina writes with a barely tilted calligraphy nib, landing between monoline strokes and razor hairlines, with lowercase as tall as cast iron capitals. Archivo answers with outward-opening curves and a commanding x-height.
gen-gf-faustina-fs-asap: A c as open as a bent paperclip gives Faustina its classic, authoritative face, with faint nib pressure across each round letter. And Asap brings low-contrast, readable sans, its body height nearly matching the capitals.
